accepted_scenarios: Actual XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost tuning for regression MSE, binary PR-AUC and declared expected cost; complete fold metrics/native fit and curve receipts.
Independent sklearn prediction references for MSE and asymmetric expected cost; correct minimizing/maximizing configuration choice and stable grid/random ties.

Unavailable R2 across random/grid/Optuna prevents a winner; malformed probabilities, incompatible objectives, aliases, contradictory directions/thresholds and invalid feature lists are handled explicitly.
Trial fitter errors retain configuration/error receipts across grid/random/Optuna. Missing curve points preserve null mean/spread and cannot generate false range guidance.
Search basis binds prepared/raw inputs, execution, objective, policy and budget; protected outcome rows are excluded. Optional Optuna fallback is explicit and bound to the resolved method.
Cooperative cancellation retains attempts without completion. API stopped/search/refit/publication/preparation errors remain errors/stopped and cannot report successful publication.
Winner API refit reuses the resolved class weight and matches the selected trial native fit receipt exactly, including input/configuration/budget/runtime.
Native tuning selection is stored under the immutable candidate manifest; modified basis rejects publication and subsequent evidence-file tampering fails integrity checks.

Authenticated temporal classification/regression tuning preserves chronology and fold-local purifier/native fit evidence, publishes the exact selected parameters and leaves prior model/bundle artifacts usable.

Accepted loss objectives reject undefined native AUC early stopping in single-class partitions. Explicitly disabling early stopping still retains complete/partial metric availability without inventing AUC.
limitations: Exploratory development evidence reuses search/early-stopping/CV/curve data; unweighted fold means and descriptive spread, no nested validation, independent assessment or paired-effect uncertainty.

Native training/early stopping remains fixed AUC/RMSE; full objective alignment remains open. F2/MCC and alternate thresholds are historical-only inputs; historical upstream transformations remain unverified.
Candidate publication runs separate post-selection development CV with frozen candidate fitter parameters; this does not reproduce the search folds or constitute independent validation.

Per-file search result projections/in-process progress remain mutable. Simultaneous jobs, immutable durable search history/recovery, forced interruption and actor/storage tamper resistance remain open.

Existing tuning request adopts a development candidate only while its parent remains current. This is not independent review, organizational policy approval, production-use approval or customer acceptance.
Native receipts and runtime/source digests are not signatures, an independent reproduction runner or qualified malicious expert-code isolation.
Private production operation, project roles/data egress, recovery/upgrade drills, mandatory expert isolation, reviewer workflow, accessibility milestone and partner/value acceptance are open.
